title: Night of shifting timelines in an LA Airbnb
summary: Brent Friedman tells of Night of shifting timelines in an LA Airbnb, about c. 2024-2025 at Airbnb, Los Angeles, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Brent Friedman, speaking on a podcast about Hollywood and UFOs, says that one night around 2024 or 2025, while staying at a rented Airbnb home in Los Angeles, he was trying to calm himself down with a mantra. He says he got in the shower to wind down and heard a voice say one word: "Timelines." He tells it as a strange night when reality itself seemed to shift around him.
